title: 第一卷 第3章 击杀鼠妖加点第一卷 第4章 各有谋划
lines: “嫂子！”
秦烈伸手想扶住她。
但柳芸娘却好像没听见一样。
整个人眼眶通红，带着一股子说不上来的狠劲儿，直接朝秦烈扑了过来。
咔擦。
屋角突然出现了一道刺耳的声音。
原本还想有所动作的柳芸娘身体立马僵住了，秦烈也顿了一下。
咔咔……
屋角的声音越来越响，一下一下，让人听得头皮发麻。
“什、什么声音……？”
柳芸娘嗫嚅，脸上刚才的潮红也已经完全褪去。
秦烈没有说话，只是突然感觉到胸前的镇妖令突然变得很烫。
他推开柳芸娘，然后立下了床，想看看究竟是什么东西。
屋角那里就放了一个破柜子，黑漆漆的，什么也看不清，声音就是从那里传出来的。
像是在啃木头，又像是在啃骨头。
“秦兄弟……”
柳芸娘下意识抓紧了衣襟，往秦烈身边靠了一步。
话还没说完，眼前的破木柜突然裂开。
砰的一声，一个巨大的黑影从里面钻了出来。
这个时候，秦烈才看清楚，是一只老鼠。
而且不是普通的老鼠，眼前这个玩意儿比秦烈认知里面的老鼠大了足足好几倍。
人立而起，已经有秦烈胸膛那么高了。
“啊！鼠妖！”
柳芸娘看到之后，吓得尖叫一声。
这个世界上有各种各样的妖怪，还都喜欢吃人肉。
有钱有势的人家里可以布置驱妖阵和武者，穷人只能听天由命。
以往只听说别人家里出现了妖怪，没想到今天跑到她们家里来了。
鼠妖趴在地上，没有立刻扑上来，而是歪着脑袋打量着秦烈和柳芸娘，眼神里充满了对食物的渴望。
秦烈咽了咽唾沫，感觉自己的喉咙有点发紧。
他知道这个世界上有妖是一回事儿，但是亲眼看到又是另一回事儿。
忽然之间，鼠妖就动了，直接一跳就窜到了柳芸娘的面前。
柳芸娘吓得尖叫一声后退几步，差点就摔倒在地。
身上的衣服本来就散着，这一褪，满是春光。
还是秦烈眼疾手快，伸手一把将她扯到自己身后。
慌乱之间，手背像是擦过一团柔软。
柳芸娘身子猛地一颤，脸色一下红到了耳根。
秦烈现在可没有心情欣赏眼前的春光，因为老鼠已经扑到面前了。
躲是躲不开了，秦烈只能本能的抬起手里的镇妖令挡在面前。
砰！
老鼠撞在镇妖令上，发出一声刺耳的怪叫。
根本不像老鼠叫，反而像小孩啼哭。
content_en:
"Sister-in-law!"
Qin Lie stretched out his hand to support her.
But Liu Yunniang didn't seem to hear it.
His eyes were red, and with an indescribable ferocity, he rushed towards Qin Lie.
Click.
A harsh sound suddenly appeared in the corner of the room.
Liu Yunniang, who originally wanted to make a move, immediately froze, and Qin Lie also paused.
Kaka...
The sounds in the corner of the room were getting louder and louder, one after another, making people's scalp numb.
"Wha, what's the sound...?"
Liu Yunniang groaned, and the flush on her face had completely faded.
Qin Lie didn't say anything, but suddenly felt that the Demon Suppression Order on his chest suddenly became very hot.
He pushed Liu Yunniang away, then stood up on the bed, wanting to see what it was.
There was a broken cabinet in the corner of the room. It was so dark that nothing could be seen clearly. That was where the sound came from.
It's like chewing wood or bones.
"Brother Qin..."
Liu Yunniang subconsciously grasped the hem of her clothes and took a step closer to Qin Lie.
Before he finished speaking, the broken wooden cabinet in front of him suddenly cracked.
With a bang, a huge black shadow emerged from inside.
Only then did Qin Lie see clearly that it was a mouse.
And it's not an ordinary mouse. The thing in front of him is several times bigger than the mouse Qin Lie knew.
The man stood up, already as high as Qin Lie's chest.
"Ah! Rat demon!"
When Liu Yuniang saw it, she screamed in fright.
There are all kinds of monsters in this world, and they all like to eat human flesh.
Rich and powerful people can arrange demon exorcism arrays and warriors in their homes, while poor people can only resign themselves to fate.
In the past, I had only heard about monsters appearing in other people's homes, but I didn't expect that they would come to their house today.
The rat demon lay on the ground and did not pounce on them immediately. Instead, he tilted his head and looked at Qin Lie and Liu Yunniang, his eyes full of desire for food.
Qin Lie swallowed and felt his throat was a little tight.
It was one thing for him to know that there were monsters in the world, but it was another thing to see it with his own eyes.
Suddenly, the rat demon moved and jumped directly in front of Liu Yunniang.
"Ah!"
Liu Yunniang screamed in fright and took a few steps back, almost falling to the ground.
The clothes on my body were already loose, but when they were taken off, they were full of spring.
Qin Lie still had quick eyes and quick hands. He stretched out his hand and pulled her behind him.
In the panic, the back of my hand seemed to have been brushed by a soft mass.
Liu Yunniang's body trembled suddenly, and her face turned red to her ears.
Qin Lie was not in the mood to appreciate the spring scenery in front of him now, because the mouse had already pounced in front of him.
There was no way to hide, so Qin Lie could only instinctively raise the Demon Suppressing Order in his hand to block it in front of him.
Bang!
The mouse bumped into the demon-suppressing order and made a piercing scream.
It doesn't sound like a mouse at all, but more like a child crying.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 3: Kill the rat demon to gain points Volume 1 Chapter 4: Everyone has their own plans
